label: Bottoms — jeans, denim, trousers
note: Authored, never generated. The back is the money shot for denim: seat fit, yoke, pocket placement and arcuate stitching are the primary purchase drivers, so the back view leads the fan-out and carries the longest MUST PRESERVE. Category styling rule: the top is tucked or cropped so the waistband and rise stay visible, and hands stay OUT of the pockets on every shot but the pocket crop — a hand in a front pocket hides the exact geometry the shot exists to sell.
preserve_fields: the exact wash and its whiskering, fading and distressing pattern
the rise and the waistband height
the leg shape from hip to hem and the hem opening width
the hardware — shank button, rivets, and the zip or button fly
the back-pocket shape, placement and any arcuate stitching
the stitching colour and density, belt loops and the hem finish

blocks.must_preserve: MUST PRESERVE EXACTLY from the references, unchanged: {{product.garment}}; and {{preserve_fields}}. Do not redraw, recolour, resize or reposition any hardware, stitching, pocket or wash detail. Do not add any extra text, logo, patch or graphic anywhere on the garment.
